يلتقطان (form VIII)
# يَلْتَقِطَانِ (yaltaqiṭāni) /jal.ta.qi.tˤaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# يُلْتَقَطَانِ (yultaqaṭāni) /jul.ta.qa.tˤaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
